local_context.value: Hollywood is a town in western Charleston County; elevation 30 ft; 2020 census population 5,339. 10.3% of residents were 65 or older in the 2000 census (no 2020 figure found). Incorporated 1949; truck farming was the base until the 1960s; by 2000 town limits covered 33 square miles, about sixteen miles along Highway 162 (spread-out, largely rural housing). No official flood-zone or hurricane fact found.

neighborhoods.value: Plantation at Stono Ferry (community with walking trails and a community dock). No official or encyclopedic neighborhood list found.

place_entities.value: Serenity Park (7.2 acres, end of Trexler Avenue, 500 ft of Stono River frontage); Hollywood Town Hall (5150 Highway 165); West County Aquatic Center (Charleston County Parks pool)

permit_office.value: Town of Hollywood Town Hall takes building, zoning, tree and electrical permit applications (Town permits portal); the Town's pages say inspections are done by Charleston County Building Inspection Services (CC&I), and the County lists Hollywood among the towns whose building permits it issues. The Town's own pages conflict on who inspects - confirm with Town Hall (843-889-3222) before stating a single office.
